# secopsctl mcp

Serve secopsctl as an MCP server and register with MCP clients

## mcp install

Register secopsctl as an MCP server in the project .mcp.json

```text
secopsctl mcp install
```

```text
Add secopsctl as an MCP server in the project-level .mcp.json so
every Claude Code session in this directory gets secopsctl tools
automatically. Idempotent — updates the entry if it already exists.
```

## mcp serve

Run secopsctl as an MCP server (stdio JSON-RPC transport)

```text
secopsctl mcp serve [flags]
```

```text
Start a Model Context Protocol server over stdin/stdout. Every
secopsctl command becomes an MCP tool; the docs/tips guides become
MCP resources. Designed for Claude Code and other MCP-aware agents.

Register with: secopsctl mcp install
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project-dir` | string | - | project root for subprocess cwd (set by mcp install) |
